gen-mystery-quest-gf-georama: Approachable Georama pulls its c apart like a bracelet beneath Mystery Quest, whose curves all have open jaws. Old-book mood above, friendly openness below: that is the draw.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-gidole: Bookish and nostalgic, Mystery Quest leaves open jaws on its curves, while Gidole traces each stroke like neon tubing. One brings storybook texture, the other keeps the line tidy.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-golos-text: Mystery Quest leans bookish, with open jaws on every curve. Golos Text, a contemporary sans, lets its x-height fill the line and parts its s widely, with no calligraphic thinning.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Open jaws on every curve give Mystery Quest its storybook, nostalgic look. Hedvig Letters Sans, plain sans with a clear gap where the c ends, keeps a page moving smoothly, its small letters nearly capital height.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-heebo: Professional Heebo stands beneath the bookish, nostalgic Mystery Quest. Heebo's tall central band and curves that stop short instead of closing give the heading's open jaws a quiet partner.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur is a modern sans with tall, stamped-metal lowercase and curves that stop well short of the stems. Its steel-cable line weight is the quiet backbone under Mystery Quest's open jaws.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-hind-madurai: Storybook swagger up top: Mystery Quest cuts open jaws into every curve, while Hind Madurai's lowercase fills the line like capitals. Both keep their curves open, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-hind-mysuru: Contemporary Hind Mysuru sits under bookish Mystery Quest. As plain sans goes, its ballpoint-steady line, ajar a's and lowercase tops pressing toward ascender height carry text along without calligraphic fuss.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-hind-siliguri: Nostalgic Mystery Quest cuts open jaws into every curve, all character and bookish flourish. Hind Siliguri, a sans-serif with rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, does the quiet work of a flat gray hum.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-hind-vadodara: Clean in every direction, Hind Vadodara holds its line thickness steady while Mystery Quest brings bookish, open-jawed curves. But Hind Vadodara's spacious terminal gaps are the quality that sticks against that old-book heading.
